heading_en: Transitional Measures Concerning Exposures to Subordinated Debt and Other Capital Instruments
summary_ja: 新告示第三十七条の五の百五十パーセントを、二年間は百パーセント又は百二十五パーセントとすることができる。
summary_en: For two years, the 150% risk weight in Article 37-5 may be replaced by 100% and then 125%, unless 150% applies under Articles 22 through 33.
paragraphs: With respect to the application of Article 37-5 of the New Public Notice for the period until the day on which two years have elapsed from the Application Date, the words "150%" in that Article may be the percentage prescribed in each of the following items according to the period category set out in that item; provided, however, that this does not apply where a risk weight of 150% applies on the date on which the consolidated capital adequacy ratio is calculated when Articles 22 through 33 of the New Public Notice are applied: (i) For one year from the Application Date: 100%; (ii) For one year from the day on which one year has elapsed from the Application Date: 125%.
